name: Taking People To Court
overview: Scripture instructs believers to pursue righteous judgment and peace in disputes, emphasizing fair treatment of others, including strangers, as seen in Deuteronomy 1:16. The Lord upholds the cause of the afflicted and the poor, assuring divine justice (Psalms 140:12). Jesus encourages believers to reconcile quickly with adversaries to avoid harsher consequences (Matthew 5:25) and to address offenses privately to restore relationships (Matthew 18:15). Generosity and forgiveness are further emphasized in Luke 6:30, teaching believers to respond with grace rather than litigation or retaliation.
